verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation about data retention policies, deletion controls, or privacy settings specific to AI features (e.g., Duo/agent-generated content) or general GitLab data lifecycle controls; nothing addresses how an AI-native user could configure retention/deletion of prompts, code context, or AI-generated artifacts. missing for 10: documented retention/deletion settings for AI features, data lifecycle/audit controls for AI-processed data, opt-out or purge mechanisms.
